features:
- [TASKBAR LIVE MASTER/SLAVE] Gan truc tiep nut chon Master va o tick Slave ngay tren dinh tung cua so Live Scrcpy. Khi chon 1 may lam Master, tat ca cac may khac tu dong an nut Master va chuyen sang hien o tick Slave. May bo tick khong bi sync nhung van mo man hinh binh thuong.
- [ZERO-LAG & HIGH-PRECISION SYNC] Toi uu toa do bang Win32 Client Area chuan xac tung diem anh va phat lenh bat dong bo Fire & Forget xoa so 100% do tre (lag).
- [BAO TOAN PHIEN DANG NHAP APP BEN THU 3] Xoa sach triet de tai khoan Google khi Change/Restore nhung bao toan 100% session dang nhap Telegram, Zalo, FB, TikTok, Game.
- [DYNAMIC VERSION UI] Dong bo hien thi phien ban dong v1.8.3 tren tieu de cua so va badge sidebar.
changelog:
- [TASKBAR LIVE SYNC] Tich hop nut Master & CheckBox Slave ngay tren taskbar cua so Live.
- [INPUT ZERO-LAG] Triet tieu do tre, chuan hoa toa do Win32 Client Area.
- [SESSION SHIELD] Bao toan phien dang nhap app khac khi change/restore.
- [VERSION DYNAMIC] Tu dong cap nhat so phien ban tren toan bo giao dien.
